title: CreatingNations
description: Build an empire. Forge its engines. Defend every inch. - Nations of the Mechanism A Create Multiplayer Modpack
body:
This is a Create SMP Modpack built for people who want to engineer, explore, and share a world. Factories hum with diesel and gears, airships cross Terralith skies, and rail networks stretch between player-built nations. Dive into Alex's Caves, claim a Nullscaped End island as your capital, or fire a Big Cannon at whoever looked at you wrong. Farmer's Delight keeps your people fed, Numismatics gives you something to trade, and Sable makes sure the destruction looks good. Whether you're decorating a city or waging war, there's always something worth doing and someone worth doing it with

THIS IS FOR A WHITELIST ONLY SERVER BY THE WAY! so the join server icon will NOT work unless you join the discord!
